title: Microtubules, anesthesia, and quantum-consciousness claims
dek: A source-led examination of what an anesthetized-rat experiment found—and what it cannot establish about quantum consciousness.
summary: A 2024 rat experiment found that epothilone B delayed loss of righting reflex under isoflurane. That result supports further study of microtubules in anesthetic response, but it does not establish a quantum mechanism, an account of human consciousness, or a connection between consciousness and the universe.
ai_disclosure: AI assisted with source discovery and organization. The Lab presents the original study, related reporting, and methodological limits as separate records; AI output is not evidence and no broad consciousness claim is presented as a finding.
